issues.title: 产品灵感日报 · 20 个新品

products.name: Astute
products.tagline: Automate your B2B brand going viral, with new media creators
products.summaryZh: 用新媒体创作者让您的B2B品牌自动走红
products.descriptionZh: Astute是首个B2B新媒体平台，从创作者合作起步。我们监测您在新媒体中的存在，围绕您的买家信任的创作者构建数据驱动的策略，并自动运行这些合作关系。这一切都在几分钟内完成。
products.description: Astute is the first B2B new media platform, starting with creator partnerships. We monitor your presence in the new media, build a data-backed strategy around the creators your buyers trust, and run the partnerships on autopilot. All within minutes.

products.name: Clipto MCP
products.tagline: Let agents source clips from terabytes of your local video
products.summaryZh: 让智能体从你本地视频的海量数据中提取片段。
products.descriptionZh: Clipto MCP让Claude、ChatGPT及其他AI代理能够从你电脑中存储的视频、照片和音频录制中获取片段及更多内容。无需手动浏览文件，只需描述你的需求。例如，将脚本转化为视频，通过将每句话与本地素材匹配；找出某人提及某个话题的每个场景；制作粗剪；或像拥有专属助理剪辑师一样搜索多年的媒体内容。
products.description: Clipto MCP gives Claude, ChatGPT, and other AI agents the ability to source clips and more from inside the videos, photos, and audio recordings stored on your computer. Instead of manually browsing files, simply describe what you need. For example, turn a script into a video by matching each sentence with your local footage; find every scene where someone mentioned a topic; create rough cuts; or search years of media as if you have a dedicated assistant editor.

products.name: Origin by Cursor
products.tagline: The Git forge built for the age of coding agents
products.summaryZh: 为编码代理时代而生的Git锻造平台
products.descriptionZh: Origin是Cursor推出的全新代码托管平台，专为人类与编程代理并肩工作的时代而设计。直接在Cursor中创建和托管Git仓库，浏览和搜索代码，打开并审查拉取请求，管理访问权限，并与GitHub同步。你的代码现在与处理它的代理相邻而居——更多面向代理的原生功能即将推出。
products.description: Origin is Cursor's new code hosting platform, built for a world where humans and coding agents work side by side. Create and host Git repos directly in Cursor, browse and search code, open and review pull requests, manage access, and sync with GitHub. Your code now lives next to the agents working on it—with more agent-native features on the way.

products.name: Claude Watermark Remover
products.tagline: Find and remove every trace AI leaves in your text
products.summaryZh: 查找并清除文本中所有AI留下的痕迹。
products.descriptionZh: 粘贴任意文本，即可查看聊天界面在其中留下的所有痕迹：隐藏的HTML类名、零宽字符、特殊空格、排版字符。每项发现都带有计数和位置，因为这些是对字节的事实描述，而非概率评分。一键清理。免费、无限量、无需账户，在浏览器中运行，因此不会上传任何内容。它不声称能检测Anthropic的统计水印，因为Anthropic之外无人能做到。引擎采用MIT开源协议。
products.description: Paste any text and see every trace a chat interface left in it: hidden HTML class names, zero-width characters, exotic spaces, typography. Each finding has a count and a position, because these are facts about the bytes, not a probability score. Clean it in one click. Free, unlimited, no account, runs in your browser so nothing is uploaded. It does not claim to detect Anthropic's statistical watermark, because nobody outside Anthropic can. The engine is MIT open source.

products.name: Hosted Agents in Cluing
products.tagline: Collaborative agents who build, learn and publish in 1 place
products.summaryZh: 协作代理，在一个地方构建、学习并发布
products.descriptionZh: Cluing托管代理将代理从个人笔记本电脑转移到协作工作空间。在电脑上开始工作，在手机上继续，并移交给团队成员而不丢失上下文。随着您收集新见解，不断演进的技能会更新，代理成为团队资产。现在任何人都可以分配任务、发布工作，并通过Cluing的自定义连接器连接到任何具有API或MCP的外部工具。合上笔记本电脑——工作将继续进行。
products.description: Cluing Hosted Agents take agents off one person’s laptop and into a collaborative workspace. Start work from your computer, continue on your phone, and hand it over to teammates without losing context. Evolving skills update as you collect new insights and agents become a team asset. Anyone can now assign tasks, publish their work, and connect to any external tool with an API or MCP with Cluing's custom connectors. Close the laptop - the work will keep going.

products.name: Expert Chase 2.0
products.tagline: Where human life runs with AI
products.summaryZh: 在人类生活与AI同行之处
products.descriptionZh: 一次彻底重新设计的体验，旨在让日常生活更简单、更互联、更有用。打开它。探索它。亲自体验它。
products.description: A completely redesigned experience, built to make everyday life feel simpler, more connected, and more useful. Open it. Explore it. Experience it yourself.

products.name: OmniVibe
products.tagline: Marketplace for agent creators & users
products.summaryZh: 面向智能体创作者与用户的市场平台
products.descriptionZh: OmniVibe将专业AI代理及其创作者汇聚于一处。对创作者而言，OmniVibe为您的代理提供了一个超越本地环境、GitHub仓库或SKILL.md的栖息之地。您可以导入并发布已有的代理，并通过合格使用获得收益。对用户来说，浏览或告知OmniVibe您的需求，它会找到合适的代理。您可以同时与多个代理协作，如同在Slack上给同事发消息一般。OmniVibe是代理创作者经济的家园。
products.description: OmniVibe brings specialized AI agents and the people who create them into one place. For creators, OmniVibe gives your agents a place to live beyond your local harness, GitHub repo, or SKILL.md. You can import and publish the agents you already have, then earn from qualified usage. For users, browse or tell OmniVibe what you need. It finds the right agents. Work with multiple agents at once, like messaging your coworkers on Slack. OmniVibe is a home for the agent creator economy.

products.name: Cronloop AI
products.tagline: AI agents that run in a loop
products.summaryZh: 循环运行的人工智能代理
products.descriptionZh: Cronloop 让你创建循环运行的 AI 代理，频率从每五分钟一次到每周一次不等。只需用纯 Markdown 描述任务，选择 Codex 或 Claude Code，连接你的工具，即可完成。每个代理都配备持久记忆系统，并能在每次运行中自我改进。立即免费创建你的第一个代理。
products.description: Cronloop lets you create AI agents that run in a loop, from every five minutes to once a week. Just describe the job in plain Markdown, pick Codex or Claude Code, connect your tools, and you're done. Every agent has a durable memory system and can self-improve each run. Create your first agent for free today.

products.name: ChatGPT for Teens
products.tagline: ChatGPT, built differently for teens
products.summaryZh: ChatGPT，专为青少年打造的不同体验
products.descriptionZh: ChatGPT for Teens是为13至17岁青少年打造的专属ChatGPT体验，围绕青少年的学习方式和AI使用习惯设计。它鼓励通过解决问题而非直接给出作业答案，提供学习模式、测验、学习可视化和学习时长功能。默认内置更强的安全保护和健康使用特性，并提供可选的家长控制，同时保持青少年的对话私密性。
products.description: ChatGPT for Teens is a dedicated ChatGPT experience for ages 13–17, designed around how teens learn and use AI. It encourages working through problems instead of simply giving homework answers, with Study Mode, quizzes, learning visualizations, and Study Hours. Stronger safety protections and healthy-use features are built in by default, with optional parental controls—while keeping teens' conversations private.

products.name: Mochi
products.tagline: A tiny animated cat for every browser tab.
products.summaryZh: 每个浏览器标签页里都有一只小巧的动画猫。
products.descriptionZh: Mochi 让你在浏览器标签页上放置一只小巧的动画猫咪伙伴，就像浏览时有个小朋友陪在身边。从20种本地猫咪风格中选择，将 Mochi 拖到任意位置，并在不同标签页间保持同一只猫在同一位置。它刻意保持小巧安静，不是生产力工具、追踪器或通知机器。无需账户、无分析、无广告、无远程数据。只是为你标签页添一只小猫 :3
products.description: Mochi lets you place a tiny animated cat companion directly on your browser tabs, like a little friend hanging out while you browse. Pick from 20 local cat styles, drag Mochi anywhere, and keep the same cat in the same spot across tabs. It’s intentionally small and quiet, not a productivity tool, tracker, or notification machine. No accounts, analytics, ads, or remote data. Just a little cat for your tabs :3

products.name: Vois 2.0
products.tagline: The ElevenLabs alternative with unlimited generation
products.summaryZh: ElevenLabs的替代方案，支持无限生成
products.descriptionZh: 桌面端的ElevenLabs替代方案。订阅即可无限文本转语音：无令牌、无用量计量、无按字符收费。100多种声音，内置同意机制的声音克隆，多说话人时间线，母带处理，导出，以及可供AI代理驱动的命令行界面。支持23种语言，Pro版通过Omni支持600多种。用于有声书、播客、无脸YouTube视频、游戏NPC配音、教程和课程，被知名公司的创作者使用。发布特惠：订阅期内每月10美元。
products.description: An ElevenLabs alternative on your desktop. Subscriptions get unlimited text to speech: no tokens, no usage meter, no per-character fees. 100+ voices, voice cloning with consent built in, a multi-speaker timeline, mastering, export, and a CLI your AI agents can drive. 23 languages, 600+ with Omni on Pro. Used for audiobooks, podcasts, faceless YouTube videos, game NPC voices, tutorials, and courses, by makers at companies you would recognize. Launch: $10/mo for the life of your subscription.

products.name: Edgemetry
products.tagline: Privacy-first web analytics on Cloudflare's free tier
products.summaryZh: 基于Cloudflare免费套餐的隐私优先网站分析
products.descriptionZh: Edgemetry是您自行运行的自有Web分析工具：一个Cloudflare Worker，一个D1数据库，无需Cookie，也无需同意横幅。一键部署，添加一个2.1 KB的脚本，即可在免费层级保留无限历史记录，大约每天2万次访问，零成本。
products.description: Edgemetry is web analytics you run yourself: one Cloudflare Worker, one D1 database, no cookies and no consent banner. Deploy in one click, add a 2.1 KB script, and keep unlimited history on the free tier, roughly 20,000 visits a day at zero cost.

products.name: KiHub
products.tagline: Hardware review platform for KiCad projects
products.summaryZh: KiCad项目硬件评测平台
products.descriptionZh: KiHub是一个面向KiCad项目的硬件审查平台。比较原理图和PCB版本，通过置顶评论讨论变更，运行自动化检查，管理审批，并保留可追溯的审查历史——无需改变你的Git工作流程。
products.description: KiHub is a hardware review platform for KiCad projects. Compare schematic and PCB revisions, discuss changes with pinned comments, run automated checks, manage approvals, and keep a traceable review history — without changing your Git workflow.

products.name: Balsa UI
products.tagline: Create design systems, build with agents
products.summaryZh: 创建设计系统，用智能体构建
products.descriptionZh: Balsa在设计系统与强大UI库之间建立了清晰的契约。其注册表提供源代码，供你的代理使用、扩展和演进。
products.description: Balsa establishes a clear contract between your design system and a powerful UI library. Its registry delivers the source code your agents can use, extend, and evolve.

products.name: Loopcase
products.tagline: Looping case study videos from your images, no keyframes
products.summaryZh: 循环播放图片中的案例研究视频，无需关键帧
products.descriptionZh: 将你的图片转化为无缝循环的案例研究和作品集视频，直接在浏览器中完成。选择模板，实时调整动态效果，导出最高4K分辨率。每次导出都能完美循环，无需关键帧，无需After Effects。免费计划即可导出真实文件，无试用限制。
products.description: Turn your images into seamlessly looping case study and portfolio videos, right in the browser. Pick a template, tune the motion live, export up to 4K. Every export loops perfectly, no keyframes, no After Effects. Free plan exports real files, no trial wall

products.name: Ressearch AI
products.tagline: AI workspace for reproducible scientific research
products.summaryZh: 可复现科学研究的AI工作空间
products.descriptionZh: Ressearch AI将整个科研工作流程整合到一个对话式工作空间中：文献检索、数据获取、Python/R分析、可视化、编辑和科学写作。AI代理在隔离的云端沙盒中执行可追溯的工作流程，使每个结果都可审查、可复现，并可从任何地方访问。无需设置。
products.description: Ressearch AI brings the entire scientific workflow into one conversational workspace: literature search, data acquisition, Python/R analysis, visualizations, editing, and scientific writing. AI agents execute traceable workflows in isolated cloud sandboxes, making every result reviewable, reproducible, and accessible from anywhere. No setup required.

products.name: BizRisk AI Analyst
products.tagline: AI-powered business due diligence and continuous monitoring.
products.summaryZh: AI驱动的企业尽职调查与持续监控。
products.descriptionZh: 使用BizRisk的AI分析师调查任何英国或爱尔兰公司、董事或域名。几分钟内获得清晰的风险报告，发现潜在问题，并持续监控重要变化。
products.description: Investigate any UK or Irish company, director or domain with BizRisk’s AI Analyst. Get a clear risk report in minutes, uncover potential concerns and continuously monitor for important changes.

products.name: Fairphone Gen 6+
products.tagline: A modular phone built to last through 2033
products.summaryZh: 一款设计用于使用至2033年的模块化手机
products.descriptionZh: 认识Fairphone Gen 6+，一款可维修的5G智能手机，提供五年保修、可更换部件、5000万像素摄像头，并支持至2033年。
products.description: Meet Fairphone Gen 6+, a repairable 5G smartphone with a five-year warranty, replaceable parts, a 50MP camera, and support through 2033.

products.name: Paper Critters
products.tagline: Kid friendly paper toys, free to decorate and COPPA safe.
products.summaryZh: 儿童友好的纸制玩具，可自由装饰，符合COPPA安全标准。
products.descriptionZh: Paper Critters将数字创意与动手玩耍融为一体。孩子们可以使用完整的贴纸控件在线设计定制纸玩具角色，然后将其打印为带有内置剪切和折叠线的即装即用手工制品。该PWA在手机、平板和桌面端完全响应式适配，可安装到主屏幕，无需从应用商店下载。免费起步，设计上对儿童安全，无需账户或邮箱，并设有审核画廊及私人保存功能。
products.description: Paper Critters bridges digital creativity with hands-on play. Kids design custom paper toy characters online using full sticker controls, then print them as ready-to-assemble crafts with built-in cut and fold lines. Fully responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop, this PWA installs to the home screen with no app store download required. It is free to start, kid-safe by design with no account or email required, and features a moderated gallery alongside private saving.

products.name: Basedash Public Sharing
products.tagline: Live dashboards for anyone you send the link to
products.summaryZh: 向任何收到链接的人提供实时仪表板。
products.descriptionZh: Basedash公共分享功能可将任意仪表盘或图表转化为带令牌的公开链接。发送给客户、投资者或利益相关者后，他们无需Basedash账户即可打开实时视图，使用筛选器、查看图表并排序公开表格。可分享整个仪表盘或单个图表，让每位接收者在浏览器中探索最新数据。无需导出，无需截图，只需发送链接即可分享实时答案。
products.description: Basedash Public Sharing turns any dashboard or chart into a tokenized public link. Send it to a client, investor, or stakeholder — they can open a live view without a Basedash account, use its filters, inspect the charts, and sort public tables. Share the whole dashboard or one chart, and let every recipient explore the latest data in their browser. No exports. No screenshots. Just send the link and share the live answer.
